# timing-defaults burst 6 interruption (2026-10-24 08:53 CEST)

Burst 6 (run 20261023T193247Z) was killed by the outer `timeout 840` in measure.sh while row 64
(vertex-streaming-s32-v1-l0, 1 iteration, unresolved at pair 4) was at pair 81. Cause: profiles.py
checks its 690 s burst budget only between rows, and an unresolved row runs to pair 255.

Disposition: the row moved to `interrupted[]` in timing-defaults.json with reason and the
pre-edit sha256 (copy: timing-defaults.pre-interrupt-disposition.json). The case reruns from
pair 0 under the unchanged rule. measure.sh: outer timeout 840 -> 1800 s, and completed streams
are skipped (phase.sh asserts on a completed stream). profiles.py is untouched, so the
source-inventory binding holds.

Rejected: resuming the row at pair 81 (needs a profiles.py change and an amendment).
Known effect: the rerun gets a second pair-4 decisiveness check; that check stops on a decisive
pass or fail alike. Reversal cost: free (the pre-edit receipt is kept).
